Location: Lincoln, MA or Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Citizenship: US Citizens only

About The Job: At Jaxon, we are on a mission to make AI trustworthy. The adoption of large language models (LLMs) in corporate settings is hindered by the “hallucination problem,” where AI models produce inaccurate or entirely fabricated responses. For regulated industries and high-risk applications, this issue is preventing LLM use altogether. This role is crucial in overcoming these challenges.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Jaxon, you will be responsible for developing and implementing machine learning models and algorithms to create more reliable AI systems. You will play a key role in delivering complex AI-driven solutions for customers, with a particular focus on defense applications as Jaxon is dual-use.

We have a patent pending product, Domain-Specific AI Language (DSAIL), that forms the basis of most of our deployments. This role will be focused on increasing security and reliability for our customers through implementing DSAIL and building on its capabilities. A particular emphasis is placed on addressing the fundamental limitations of LLMs – they don’t understand context and logical reasoning. Once an LLM deviates from the right path, errors are more likely to occur. Training an AI away from this type of yes/no logic and into more human-like reasoning is at the core of this position.

The Basics Of This Role Requires The Ability To
• Collaborate Across Teams: Work with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into our existing systems and workflows, enhancing product capabilities.
• Optimize Data Processing and Model Performance: Conduct comprehensive data management including preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation to improve accuracy and efficiency.
• Technical Proficiency: Demonstrate solid machine learning engineering experience, particularly with NLP applications and unstructured data in a cloud environment. Fluency in Python is essential.
• Understand Machine Learning Models: Needs to be intimately familiar with the process, but deploying ML models will not be a regular part of the job.

Soft Skills
• Able to context switch as needed

• Able to communicate clearly and precisely - not just abstractions and "lines-and-boxes"

• Familiarity with calling web API's and making web API's

Nice-To-Haves

At CSIS we actively seek to employ a diverse group of people who embody our organizational values. We welcome and encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply, especially those from traditionally underrepresented groups.

The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) is a non-profit, bipartisan public policy organization established in 1962 to provide strategic insights and practical policy solutions to decision makers concerned with global security and prosperity. Job summaryAmazon is looking for a passionate, talented, tech lead and manager of Applied Scientists with a strong computer vision and machine learning background to lead and grow a best-in-class research team focused on document understanding in Amazon AI Labs.
Amazon AI Labs Computer Vision is part of Amazon Web Services (AWS), the world-leading provider of cloud services.
AWS has fostered the creation and growth of countless new businesses, and is a positive force for good.
The AI Labs Computer Vision team regularly publishes at top conferences and works with Product and Engineering teams to launch computer vision APIs such as Amazon Rekognition, Textract, and model customization services such as Custom Labels and Lookout for Vision.
We are looking for an Applied Science Manager/Tech Lead for our fast growing Textract service.
Your challenge is to create solutions at the intersection of computer vision and natural language processing for the extraction of text and structured data from documents and delight a wide range of customers spanning domains such as mortgage, insurance, health care and tax processing.
In developing such solutions, you will lead best-in-class research in unsupervised, self-supervised and semi-supervised methods, active learning and semi-automated data annotation, document OCR and scene text recognition, visual question answering, joint vision and language models, extracting tabular data from documents, document understanding, and layout understanding.
You will have to be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and produce solutions that scale to a diversity of customer problems.
You will partner with engineering and business teams to solve hard science problems inspired by real-world use-cases, have access to virtually endless data and computational resources, and to world-class engineers and developers that can help bring your research ideas into the world.
We solve real problems that delight our customers, which gives even the most theoretically-minded scientist purpose and gratification.
We are located in Seattle, Bellevue, Pasadena, Palo Alto, Atlanta (USA) and in Haifa and Tel Aviv (Israel).
Inclusive Team CultureHere at AWS, we embrace our differences.
We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion.
We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally.
We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences.

It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life.
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment.
We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
